name: 16201 · Kittanning, PA
findings: ZIP 16201 (Kittanning) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16201 (Kittanning) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16201 (Kittanning) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
